brief:
Middle East Eye reports that UK Foreign Secretary David Miliband has indicated a policy shift in British Middle East strategy, suggesting the government faces pressure to take a clearer stance on regional issues. The commentary indicates tension between acknowledging past positions on Gaza and maintaining current policy directions.

The piece suggests the UK government faces credibility challenges in addressing Palestinian concerns while pursuing its broader Middle East strategy, though specific details of the proposed policy shift remain unclear from the available text.

title: UK must choose clarity over ambiguity on Middle East, Miliband signals
